title: Clearer nanobanana refusals
summary:
Clearer image-model errors and a fresh runway for Hacktoberfest contributors.

Nanobanana now returns Vertex AI's actual refusal reasons instead of leaving people to decode a generic error. When a prompt gets blocked, the API can finally say why.

The project has been adapted for Hacktoberfest 2025, making the annual open-source contribution swarm a little easier to navigate.
